title: Replication Data for: Informal settlement residential choice under wildfire risk choice
descriptions: This data was collected in Imizamo Yethu by Thula Thula for the research papers: Christ, S., Schwarz, N., & Sliuzas, R. (2023). Understanding residential choice under risk: A case study of settlement fire and wildfire risk. Habitat International, 136, 102815. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.habitatint.2023.102815 and Christ, S., Schwarz, N., & Sliuzas, R. (2022). Measuring fire risk perception of residents before and after a fire. In D. Veigas & L. Ribeiro (Eds.), Advances in Forest fire Research 2022. Full details on data collection is available in the above mentioned open science papers. The first dataset represents before fire data and the second post fire data.
